g.yas ri gser chen gser chung nas slebs byung //la la sa sa blo la ma sa sa la la sa la la sa (khang dmar rdzong /)ri bo la g.yas ri g.yon ri zer//gser gyi ri la gcig bzhugs yod la//gser gyi ri la gnyis bzhugs yod la//ri bo la de 'dra'i sgang zhig zer na//gser gyi bya pho gcig bzhugs yod la//gser gyi bya pho gnyis bzhugs yod la//'dabs shog g.yas pa'i 'og shig de na//gser gyi yig chung gcig bzhugs yod la//gser gyi yig chung gnyis bzhugs yod la ze//yig chung de 'dra'i nang zhig zer na//gtam du snyan po zhig bzhugs yod la//tshig la snyan po zhig bzhugs yod zer//phu na bla ma bzang po'i bka' chos dar zhing rgyas pa'i//gtam du snyan po zhig bzhugs yod zer//tshig la tsho po 'dra zhig bzhugs yod zer//bar na dpon po bzang po'i khrims ra dar//dar zhing rgyas pa'i gtam du brtan po zhig bzhugs yod//tshig la tsho po de 'dra gcig bzhugs yod//mda' na pha ma bzang po'i gces phrug /dar zhing rgyas pa'i gtam du snyan po gcig bzhugs yod//tshig la tsho po 'dra zhig bzhugs yod//99

la la la sa sa la la sa la la la sa la (rgyal rtse rdzong /)rtsa sna bal po'i sman grog kho'i dkyil na//bas dkar lcang ma'i gra lu dang 'dra byung //rgya bsang mkhan pa'i rtsa ba kho bton dus//'jol mo chu la rub pa dang 'dra byung //bye bde'i gad pa'i gad steng du slebs dus//lug gu khyu 'phag brgyab pa dang 'dra byung //zom gyi ma lhas chen mo kho'i nang du//dung zho 'o mas bkang ba dang 'dra byung //lho yi gad pa'i gad steng du slebs dus//sprin dkar la mo thon pa dang 'dra byung //lhas ra gseb lhas chen mo kho'i nang du//dung zho 'o mas bkang ba dang 'dra byung //gzhis chen klu yi pho brang du slebs dus//nang mi sku khams chu rgyun las bzang ba//sman la shes bya'i sdong po mo'i zhal nas//g.yang dpon thugs bsun 'o brgyal ma byung ngam//nga la bsun snang 'o brgyal ni ma byung ngo //ma sa ma la sa sa sa sa ma ma la la sa sa (ngam ring rdzong /)bcu la tham pa bcu gcig dang bcu gnyis//bcu la gsum dang bcu bzhi dang bco lnga//— lnga brgya'i zho la grang dkrog kyang thebs song //100

rgya chu tsha grang ran pa zhig 'khur shog /zho mo'i gting nas ma 'khrug ni zer na//dpung chung g.yas g.yon ma non pa min 'gro//zho mo'i kha nas bzhur song ni zer na//rgya chu tsha grang ma ran pa min nam//zho mo ma 'khrug kha bzhu dag no ko//byis pas nyams tshod mi lon pas byed kyis//rgya zho'i nyams tshod mi lon pas byed kyis//ser po'i mar la 'dam 'don zhig byed dus//a ce ga ga rig rig /ma mo lu gur rig rig /lu gu zho la rig rig /rig rig brgya yang song ngo //rig rig stong yang song ngo //da rang len dus yin//da rang khrid dus yin//a ce ga ga rig rig /ma mo lu gur rig rig /khyod las rgan pa yod do//ma chen shwa ba yod//ma rer bu re yod//tsha bo rer zhang re yod//khyod las chung ba yod//la ga blo bzang yod//ma rer bu re yod//101

tsha bo rer zhang re yod//khyod las chung ba yod//la ga blo bzang yod//ma rer bu re yod//tsha bo rer zhang re yod//mtho ba gnam la bltos//gnam la skar ma 'dug /skar ma bya ma 'dug /ma rer bu re yod//tsha bo rer zhang re yod//dma' ba sa la bltos//sa la byi ba 'dug /byi ba smug chung 'dug /ma rer bu re yod//tsha bo rer zhang re yod//khyod kyis blangs zer na//nga la lung pa yod//lha lung g.yang chags yod//nga la spang ri yod//gser gzhong kha sprod yod//nga la na kha yod//gser gyi gzhong pa yod//nga la chu mig yod//dngul gyi chu mig yod//102

rgya srang nyis stong tsam zhig 'khyer shog /dkrog chen rigs gsum mgon po dag no ko//mda' yi grong sde spyi la bskur 'gro//dkrog mar ser po bcag bcag byas pa no ko//g.yag dpon bsod nams stobs rgyal ngas byas//dkrog chung ngang pa'i sgo nga tsam brton nas//gnag g.yog khug rta nag chung la ster 'gro//sa sa sa sa sa sa la la la sa la la sa lu gu skyes bsu'i glu/sa la sa la la la la sa la sa la sa sa (sa skya rdzong /)g.yang mo ma nyal longs shog /spang rtswa kha gang zo dang //nyin mo mig gis 'tshos yod//mig zur bltas nas 'tshos yod//mtshan mo skad la nyan yod//skad kyi gdangs la nyan yod//khyod kyis ma len zer yang //nga la gcur khang yod do//sa dong gting ring yod do//nyi ma shar gyi min 'dug /103

rlung po brgyab kyi min 'dug /ma mos kha la ma nyan//rang sdug rang gis myangs yong //len pa'i dus la slebs song //ma mos skad ngan ma brgyab//ma dang bu yang bral song //g.yang mo g.yang phrug 'khrid de//spang stod phyogs la phebs dang //ma sa sa sa la sa sa sa sa la sa rtswa brnga glu/sa sa sa sa la sa la sa sa sa sa (nag chu 'om bu/)rgya zor yu ba gug byung //g.yug zor gtong dgos ma bsam//skar ma g.yug pa shar song //g.yug zor gtong dgos ma bsam//'brog pas btsas ma mi shes//thu lu (nyung ma )'bu la btang song //sa gzhi pad+ma 'dab brgyad//rdib pa'i dogs ni mi 'dug /o lo'i rkang chung g.yas pa//104

chag pa'i dogs ni mi 'dug /a pa lags/ bco lnga lha mo rgyobs shog a//pha yul phyogs kyi 'grul pa//rin chen gser las dkon song //las rogs bzang po can gyi//nor pa srong rogs gnang dang //lag shes yod na slob— rogs//105

ma ༷ pa/ ༷ ༷ ad ga'as/ ༷ ༷ ༷༷༷ / / rte gyang brdung glu/sa sa la sa sa sa ma blo sa ma sa la sa (ri bo che rdzong /)steng dga' ldan lha yi mdun sa nas//sprin dkar po snyegs pa'i rtse mo ru//skyabs kun 'dus blo bzang grags pa mkhyen//deng mdun gyi nam mkhar gshegs su gsol//shog lo yag mo gyang la shog /gnas spyi gtsug seng khri nyi zla'i steng //yid dran sems snying gi gdung ba sel//shog lo yag mo gyang la shog /dpal he ru ka dang dbyer med pa'i//rje drin chen bla ma rin po che//de ring gyang pa'i skyabs gnas mdzod//shog lo yag mo gyang la shog /mgon gsang gsum bkod pa mtha' yas pa//106

rgyud dbyer med gcig tu gsol 'debs na//rgyud nyon mongs rtsub re zhi ba shog /shog lo yag mo gyang la shog /phyi stong gsum 'jig rten yangs pa'i snod//dpal lha klu mi yi yod dgu'i rdzas//de ring nga tsho'i gyang la shog /shog lo yag mo gyang la shog /yong sa ma tshang med pa phyur bur spung //rje bla ma mnyes phyir 'bul bar bgyi//nged gyang brdung bsod nams 'phel bar shog /shog lo yag mo gyang la shog /gnas sa 'dzin mthon po lhun chags pa//ri sman bzang skye dngos dri bzang ldan//rje sman pa'i phyag la son pa shog /gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /chab chu bo'i rgyun bzang g.yas nas bskor//rje bde gshegs kun gyi byin gyi rlobs//srog sems can kun gyi 'thung chu yin//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /thub bstan gyi mdo sngags dar zhing rgyas//'phags tshogs kyi 'dus sde gling chen mo//bstan go 'phangs mtho ba'i bkris shog /gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /bkra shis gtsug lag khang chen 'di//107

deng lhag bsam dag pas legs bzhengs pas//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /rgyab ri dkar po lha rgyas de//dar dkar ser dbu gdugs phub 'dra//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /g.yas ri ngam gyi skyid tshal la//rtsibs stong ldan pa'i 'khor lo mtshon//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /g.yon ri rdzong snye zog 'phyor de//dge legs rgyal mtshan bsgrengs pa 'dra//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /spos ldan shing sna'i bang mdzod de//dpal be'u ris mo mdzes par bkra//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /mdun phyogs rma bya gdong mgo de//chu bzang g.yu yi thang chen 'dra//nya gser mig mtsho nang 'khyug pa 'dra//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /shar phyogs rta la'i rdza rgyud de//stag skya be rngams shing 'gying ba 'dra//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /lho phyogs mnga' rgyas 'bab chu 'di//g.yu 'brug mkha' la 'gying ba 'dra//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /108

nub phyogs ma nom ri dmar 'di//thang dkar rgod po mkha' la lding ba 'dra// gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /byang phyogs dpal gnam ri bo de//rus sbal mtsho nas mchong ba 'dra//gyang legs yag mo gyang la shog /gyang brdung bar phyogs mi yi yul du brdung //srub med shel gyi ngo ltar 'jam//gyang kha mtho po lha yi yul du thon//shing bzo mkhas pas lha khang 'geb re ran//dbu zlum lcang lo can rnams 'tshog re ran//bla ma dam pas rab gnas mdzad re ran//gnyer pa chen pos gyang ston mdzad re ran//ja ma chang mas ja chang 'dren re ran//bkra shis gyang glu ring po 'di ltar len//'gag med gsung gi bkra shis gyang la shog /mtha' yas yon tan bkra shis gyang la shog /'dod dgu 'bad med lhun grub gyang la shog /la la la mjamajablo la blo sa sa sa la r+sājas sa (snye mo rdzong /)pha yul g.ya' brag gangs la//gangs kyi sked pa zin bzhag /gangs kyi sked pa zin yang //gangs la dbyar dgun yod 'dra//109

khang pa khang pa yag ga /de las lha rten yag ga /lha rten yag pa'i sgang la//dar lcog dkar dmar khra gsum//sa pas sa zhig 'khyer shog /rdo pas rdo zhig 'khyer shog /sa rdo 'dres ma byung na//rgyal po'i pho brang bzhengs chog /g.yag sde khang gsar gzhung la//pad+ma ser po'i me tog /dbyar kha 'ong kha'i rgyan cha//dgun kha rta po'i chag phyur//sa sa sa la la blo blo la la sa (nag chu rdzong /)rdo gru bzhi 'khyer shog rmang gzhi bzhag /rmang lo rabs rten pas rmang gzhi bzhag /gyang ram gser gyi rlung gshog 'di//spar mi dgos yar yar 'phar yong red//gyi sril spos thor bsham 'dra 'di//spos thor lha la bsham 'dra yod//rgyab byi'u kha la brgyab pa 'di//110

mkhar brtsigs thog byi'u chung babs 'dra yod//phus mig g.yang skyob bsham 'dra 'di//g.yang skyob lha la bsham 'dra yod//byang sa gser rtse sel ma la//brdung mi dgos gdas du chog sa yod//gyang thog gnam lcags tho rgod 'di//brdung mi dgos bzung du chog sa yod//gyang brdung mkhan mi de thang dkar 'dra//thang dkar thang la bab 'dra yod//gyang 'khrab mi de thang smug 'dra//thang smug g.yas skor 'khyil le le//gyang ba mi de stag shar 'dra//stag shar stag 'khyab byed pa 'dra//sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa la la ar ka bcog pa'i gzhas/ sa sa sa sa la la sa la sa sa la la (lha sa khren kon chus/)gcig gnyis gsum byas nas 'bog to sgrig shogagacig gnyis gsum byas/bzhi lnga drug byas/thig la rgya thigakhrom pas yar re gsan/o lo'i glu rkang tshig gsum e shes bltas//111

shes pa 'dug na gzhas la ram skyor gnang //ma shes 'dug na gzhas rar gzigs mo gzigs//shes la ma shes gzhas rar phan thogs med//nga la pho brang dmar po'i bshad pa yod//pho brang dmar po byu ru'i sdong po 'dra//bde yangs shar de skar ma smin drug 'dra//pho brang dmar po smin drug bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho smin drug 'bul mkhan 'dra//rta lam sgor mo bkra shis khra ring 'dra//phun tshogs 'du lam zhal thang bkram pa 'dra//pho brang dmar po zhal thang bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho zhal thang 'bul mkhan 'dra//lcang gseb shar de g.yu yi gzhong pa 'dra//pho brang dmar po g.yu gzhong bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho g.yu gzhong 'bul mkhan 'dra//g.yu thog zam pa g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal 'dra//pho brang dmar po maṇ+ḍal bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho yar la 'bul mkhan 'dra//rdo ring phyi ma gnam gyi ka ba 'dra//pho brang dmar po ka ba bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho yar la 'bul mkhan 'dra//brag sgo ka ṇi zhal zas sgrig pa 'dra//pho brang dmar po zhal zas bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho yar la 'bul mkhan 'dra//112

dmar po ri de glang chen nyal ba 'dra//pho brang dmar po glang chen bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho glang chen 'bul mkhan 'dra//bye rags de ni phye mar spungs pa 'dra//pho brang dmar po phye mar bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho yar la 'bul mkhan 'dra//lcags po ri ni gser gyi snag bum 'dra//pho brang dmar po snag bum bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho snag bum 'bul mkhan 'dra//rkyang thang na kha shog bu rgya shog 'dra//pho brang dmar po rgya shog bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho rgya shog 'bul mkhan 'dra//dar chen ring po smyu gu rgya smyug 'dra//pho brang dmar po rgya smyug bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho rgya smyug 'bul mkhan 'dra//nor bu gling kha me tog ldum ra 'dra//pho brang dmar po me tog bzhes mkhan 'dra//gzhon pa nga tsho me tog 'bul mkhan 'dra//lha sa'i skyid chu sngon mo//snag tsha yin na bsam byung //ri 'di bum pa ri 'di//snag bum yin na bsam byung //113

rkyang thang na kha'i spang gshongs//shog bu yin na bsam byung //gling bzhi dar chen bzhi po//smyu gu yin na bsam byung //nga la gnas ri drug gi bshad pa yod//gnas ri dang po rtsed thang gong po ri//spre'u rgan byang chub sems dpa'i gnas ri red//spre'u phrug rnams kyi rtsed ra gong ma red//gnas ri gnyis pa bsam yas has po ri//bla ma o rgyan pad+ma'i bzhugs gnas red//lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags gnas red//gnas ri gsum pa gnyi shang 'gur rta ri//dbang phyug mi la ras pa'i sgrub gnas red//khyi ra ras pa rjes su bzung gnas red//gnas ri bzhi pa lcags zam chu bo ri//grub dbang thang stong rgyal po'i bzhugs gnas red//zam chen zam chung bka' bkod gnang sa red//gnas ri lnga pa dbus kyi dge 'phel ri//mkhas grub 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i gdan sa red//dpal ldan 'bras dkar spungs pa'i rgyab ri red//gnas ri drug pa lha sa'i lcags po ri//lha rje sman pa brgya yi bzhugs gnas red//nad 'joms sman gyi sbyor ba gnang sa red//114

nga yi gnas ri drug gi bshad pa rdzogs//gzhon pas bshad pa ma zhus bshad pa zhus//gzhon pas dgos 'dod kun 'byung bshad pa zhus//drang srong chen po'i phyag tu nor bu bzhes//spyan gyis legs par gzigs nas 'di ltar gsungs//nor bu 'di la zur gcig tshang nas 'dug /zur gcig lha yi nor bu tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur gnyis tshang nas 'dug /zur gnyis klu yi nor bu tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur gsum tshang nas 'dug /zur gsum rigs gsum mgon po tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur bzhi tshang nas 'dug /zur bzhi rgyal chen rigs bzhi tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur lnga tshang nas 'dug /zur lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur drug tshang nas 'dug /zur drug 'gro ba rigs drug tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur bdun tshang nas 'dug /zur bdun rgyal srid sna bdun tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur brgyad tshang nas 'dug /zur brgyad bkra shis rtags brgyad tshang nas 'dug /nor bu 'di la zur dgu tshang nas 'dug /zur dgu dgos 'dod kun 'byung tshang nas 'dug /115

nga yi dgos 'dod kun 'byung bshad pa rdzogs//sa la sa sa sa la sa la sa sa sa sa sa sa sa sa (stod lung bde chen rdzong /)ar rgyab gtsang po brgal nas yong ba yin//chu de chu ban gang la zhed dgos med//bye rag la mo brgyab nas yong ba yin//bye ma mdzub shags gang la zhed dgos med//ar ka mang po bcag nas yong ba yin//gzhas dpon mtheb tog tsam la zhed dgos med//ser po gser la tag tag gtong yas yin//rag skyogs ser po ma brdung rang brdung red//sngon mo'i g.yu la tag tag yong yas yin//do lo sngon mo ma btags rang btags red//dkar po'i dngul la tag tag yong yas yin//dkar po'i ha yang ma bskol rang bskol red//ar ka bcag par tag tag yong yas red//gzhas dpon thebs chag ma rgyugs rang rgyugs red//a tsi ma gzhi sku rtsed zhus pa yin//sku rtsed bang ga thal song chos grogs tsho//chos grogs dgung bsangs phyogs la ma thad cig /de ring ar ka bcag sar bzhugs rogs gnang //sa sa la la sa la la la sa sa sa sa la sa sa sa sa (sne gdong rdzong /)gzhon pa'i bzhugs khang mi bcag bzhugs khang bcag /116

gzhon pa'i bzhugs khang chos 'khoralha sar bcag /gnas bdag ma gcig dpal lhar bzhugs khang bcag /phyi la ma 'gyur sde chen brtsig pa brtsigs nas yod//nang la ma 'gyur rdo chung lhas ma slasanas yod//pha ri'i tsan dan sdong po'i ka ba btsugs nas yod//tshur ri'i lha shing shug pa'i gdung mabatang nas yod//tsa ri'i nang gi smyug mas dral ma brgyab nas yod//rgya dkar lha rdo dkar pos dral rdo brgyab nas yod//sa de tshi can gyi thog 'dag brgyab nas yod//lha sa skyid chu sngon mos 'dag chu zhusanas yod//thog chang yi la a rag bdud rtsi zhus//jab khra yi la gser gshog dngul gshog yod//yar zes yi la skar ma smin drug yod//'gyogs mkhan yi la dman chung bumo yod//mchod mkhan yi la stag shar gzhon pa yod//gzhon pa'i bzhugs khang ma bcagabazhugs khang bcag /gzhon pa'i bzhugs khang bsam yas gzhung la bcag /gnas bdag chos skyong chen po'i bzhugs khang bcag /gzhon pa'i bzhugs khang ma bcagabazhugs khang bcag /gzhon pa'i bzhugs khang g.yu rongakhra 'brug bcag /gnas bdag rje btsun sgrol ma'i bzhugs khang bcag /sa sa sa sa stengs sa sa sa sa sa sa 44 sa sa sa 4(gra nang rdzong /)dgung bsangs mthon po rnam tsho gling gi bu//117

gzhon pa nga tsho dro 'jam nyi ma 'dra//dro 'jam gling bzhi skor dus 'dug ze skor//bag chags yag po bzhag dus 'dug ze bzhag /zhabs bro de tsho rkang pa 'khyag tsam gnang //zhabs bro de tsho pus mo gug tsam gnang //pus mo chos kyi 'khor lo 'gug tsam gnang //zhabs bro de tsho sked pa ldem tsam gnang //rdo rje dril bu bla ma'i phyag la phul//zhabs bro de tsho lag pa ther tsam gnang //thang dkar rgod pos nam mkha' bshags pa 'dra//zhabs bro de tsho dpung pa rong tsam gnang //dbu la rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhes pa 'dra//gcig gnyis/ gsum byas nas/ rdog gral bsgril zhogs/gcig gnyis/ gsum/ gcig gnyis/ gsum/byang phyogs byang nas phebs pa'i bya chen o rog /bya chen khyed rang phebs phebs ga nas phebs//yang bskyar do nub thad thad ga par thad//nga rang yong yong gling dkar stod nas yong //do nub 'gro 'gro dga' ba'i gzhung la 'gro//khyed kyi yab yum gnyis ka sku khams bzang //sku khams bzang lugs sngar las lhag /gtam ngan bzhog rgyu med pa'i dam bca' bzhag /tshes pa bcu dang bco lnga'i dus bzang la/118

gru shan rta mgo brgya yi bsu ba zhus//dung pa rgya gling rnams la sbyor brda sprod//bro pa gzhas ma rnams kyi gra sgrig byed//thug dang rgyal mtshan gnyis la na bza' sgron//sgo dang sge'u khung gnyis la phyis bdar spros//zhogs pa bya pho yi la dpe zhig blangs//zhogs pa langs pa'i sngon ma bu mos byas//grong skas yar 'dzegs mar babs bu mos byas//a ma'i gser g.yu mu tig bu mor bdag /sa sa sa la sa la sa ge sa sa sa sa sa sa (mtsho sna rdzong /)so ya la/ a la rgya stod khrom pa'i sta re gzhus/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ chos 'khor lha sa phyi yi lcags ri 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ bstan pa'i jo bo nang gi nor bu 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ phyi yi lcags ri nang la ma 'gyur shig ya la so'o/so ya la/ nang gi nor bu phyi la 'gyur don med/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ bsam yas gnas nang phyi yi lcags ri 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ a ma chos sgron nang gi nor bu 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ phyi yi lcags ri nang la 'gyur dgos med/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ nang gi lcags ri phyi la 'gyur dogs med/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ rgyal po chen po nang gi nor bu 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ khra 'brug gnas nang phyi yi lcags ri 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ phyi yi lcags ri nang la ma 'gyur shig ya la so'o/so ya la/ nang gi nor bu phyi la 'gyur don med/ ya la so'o/119

so ya la/ zhabs bro shes pas rkang pa 'khyag se 'khyag ya la so'o/so ya la/ rkang pa sha yi 'bog to 'khyag se 'khyag ya la so'o/so ya la/ zhabs bro shes nas pus mo rub se rub/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ zhabs bro shes nas sked pa ldem se ldem/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ zhabs bro shes nas dpung pa rong se rong / ya la so'o/so ya la/ thang dkar rgod po sha la rgyugs pa 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ zhabs bro shes nas dbu la 'jog se 'jog ya la so'o/so ya la/ dbu la rgyal ba rigs lnga mchod pa 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ dbu la dbu zhwa mchod pa 'dra/ ya la so'o/so ya la/ dbu lcang rgyab la g.yugs pa 'dra/ ya la so'o/nor gling rdo gcal sgang la/so'o ya la/ wan/ khru'u/ (dbyin skad/)bka' shag lhan rgyas tshogs bzhagayar la mjal dar phul bas/mar la ljags mdud gnang byung /so'o ya la/ wan/ khru'u/mar la ljags mdud gnang byung /ljags mdud ske la btags nas/pha yul phyogs la log 'gro/la la la la la sa sa la la sa ('phyongs rgyas rdzong /)bstan rgyas gling gi chos ra gshong gshong na/120

bstan rgyas gling gi chos ra gshong gshong na/bstan pa chos kyi slob dpon pad ma bzhugs/ya 'a la/slob dpon pad+ma bzhugs/si ci'i phyogs la 'ur/bi ci'i phyogs la 'ur/si ci'i bi ci'i phyogs la 'ur/ 'ur/ 'ur/ 'ur/so ya la/ a ce 'dzoms pas ma phyin 'dzoms pas phyin/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ a ce 'dzoms pas rgod dkar la la phyin/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ rgod dkar la la a ce'i zhabs phyags lus/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ zhabs phyags zhabs phyags 'dra sa med/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ gtsang la rgyal rtse zhol nas nyos pa yin/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ lha sa nor bu gling la khrom thog bcad/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ sprad pa la ni srang gang zho brgyad sprad/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ sprod rgyu la ni kha gang skar ma bsdad/ so'o ya la/ so ya la/ de ni bla ma bzang po'i phyag tu 'bul/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ bla ma gang byung mang byung 'bul gyi min/ so'o ya la/so ya la/ gcod pa yab sras gsum la 'bul rgyu yin/ so'o ya la/chos skor lha sa'i g.yas phyogs nas// zhob zhob zhob/ma gcig dpal lha'i g.yon phyogs nas//dga' skyid 'dzoms pa'i bro gcig 'khrab//bro la 'khrab pa'i dus su ma 'khrab na//121

nam zhag gtan du bro pa'i dgos pa med//bsam yas phyi ma'i g.yas phyogs nas//chos skyong chen mo'i g.yon phyogs nas//dga' skyid 'dzoms pa'i bro zhig 'khyab//bro la 'khrab pa'i dus su ma 'khrab na//nam zhag gtan du bro pa'i dgos pa med//khra 'brug phyi ma'i g.yas phyogs nas//sgrol ma gsung byon g.yon phyogs nas//dga' skyid 'dzoms pa'i bro zhig 'khrab//bro la 'khrab pa'i dus su ma 'khrab na//nam zhag gtan du bro pa'i dgos pa med//ma blo sa la la sa la la sa sa la sa blo sa (chu gsum rdzong /)gcig gnyis/ gsum byas pa'i rdog gral sgrigs shogabazhi/ lnga/ drug byas pa'i gzhas mo gtong /ar ka sa ni ma red/ ar ka rdo ni ma red/ar ka sa min rdo min/gzims chung 'od kyis khengs song /o los bshad pa ma shod bshad pa shod//o los star sdong phra mo'i bshad pa shod//lto zhig za na star ga'i nang khrol za//122

lto de las zhim pa gcig kyang med//skom zhig 'thung na star ga'i star chu 'thung //skom de las zhim pa gcig kyang med//gos shig gyon na ltar ga'i lo ma gyon//gos de las dro ba gcig kyang med//de nas star sdong phra mo'i bshad pa rdzogs//de nas mtsho stod gsum gyi bshad pa yod//mtsho stod yi la gser gyi mda' gcig brgyab//gser sku phyag na rdo rje'i mda' gcig brgyab//mtsho dkyil 'di la g.yu yi mda' gcig brgyab//g.yu yi sgrol ma gsung byon mda' gcig brgyab//mtsho bzhugs ma la dung gi mda' gcig brgyab//dgon pa'i tshogs dung dkar po'i mda' gcig brgyab//de nas mtsho stod gsum gyi bshad pa rdzogs//de nas sgo nga gsum gyi bshad pa yod//sgo nga dang po ma btang dang po btang //sgo nga dang po nam mkha'i dkyil la btang //nam mkhar skar gral 'grigs po de nas byung //sgo nga gnyis pa ma btang gnyis pa btang //sgo nga gnyis pa lha sa gzhung la btang //lha sa mi tshogs mthug po de nas byung //sgo nga gsum pa ma btang gsum pa btang //123

sgo nga gsum pa 'phyongs rgyas gzhung la btang //'phyongs rgyas mi spus dag po de nas byung //de nas sgo nga gsum gyi bshad pa rdzogs//gdan sa mthil la dgon chung brgyab shog gsung //gdan sa mthil la dgon chung brgyab shog gsung //gdan sa mthil la dgon chung brgyab nas bzhag yod//rdo chen rnams tsho brtsigs pa brtsigs nas bzhag yod//rdo chung rnams tsho lhas ma bslas nas bzhag yod//ser po gser gyi ka ba tshugs shog gsungs byung //ser po gser gyi ka ba btsugs nas bzhag yod//sngon po g.yu yi gdung ma snon shog gsungs byung //sngon mo g.yu yi gdung ma snon nas bzhag yod//tsan dan sdong po'i lcang ma gtong shog gsungs byung //tsan dan sdong po'i lcang ma btang nas bzhag yod//tsa ri'i smyug ma'i gral ma sgrig shog gsung byung //tsa ri'i sgyug ma'i gral ma bsgrig nas bzhag yod//g.yu dang byu ru'i gral rdo brgyab shog gsungs byung //g.yu dang byu ru'i gral rdo brgyab nas bzhag yod//sbrang char zil ma'i 'dam chu brgyab shog gsungs byung //sbrang char zil ma'i 'dam chu brgyab nas bzhag yod//bye ma ka ra'i thog 'dag brgyab shog gsung byung //bye ma ka ra'i thog 'dag brgyab nas bzhag yod//dman chung bu mos thog chang 'khyer shog gsungs byung //124

dman chung bu mos thog chang bkyag nas bzhag yod//stag shar gzhon pas ar ka gcog shog gsungs byung //stag shar gzhon pas ar ka bcag nas bzhag yod//yul du med pa'i lha rten brgyab shog gsungs byung //yul du med pa'i lha rten brgyab nas bzhag yod//ṭam ka dkar po'i bad g.yam sgrig shog gsungs byung //ṭam ka dkar po'i bad g.yam bsgrig nas bzhag yod//dar sne lnga yi dar lcog btsugs nas bzhag yod//la la la la sa sa sa la la la la la sa sa la (lhun rtse rdzong /)bsam yas gnas la ar po brgyab shog zer//rdo chen rnams tsho brtsig pa brtsigs nas bzhag /rdo chung rnams tsho lhas ma bslas nas bzhag /ser po gser gyi ka ba btsugs nas bzhag /sngon po g.yu yi gdung ma btang nas bzhag /pa ṭa shug pa'i dral ma btang nas bzhag /ṭam ka dkar po'i lcam mal brgyab nas bzhag /mu tig sa yi thigs sa brgyab nas bzhag /nag po lcags 'dra'i g.yam pa btang nas bzhag /dmar po zangs kyi or pa btsugs nas bzhag /la la la sa la la la sa sa la la la sa la sa (gong dkar rdzong /)gcig gnyis/ gsum byas/bzhi/ lnga/ drug byas/125

khyed rang brgya sde khrom pa snyan re gsan//o los glu gar tshig gsum e shes bltas//shes pa rnams tshos gzhas la rogs skyor gnang //ma shes rnams tshos gzhas la gzigs mo gzigs//ma shes gzhas la phebs na ngo re tsha//ma shes gzhas la zhugs na yid rang mug /gnas la dang po ma chags dang po chags//gnas la dang po rdo rje brag phug chags//gnas chags nas gnas bshad ma btang na//dang po slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' dang 'gal//gnyis pa chos grogs nga tsho'i dam tshig 'gal//chos grogs dang chos grogs 'dra sa med//gnas bzang tsa ri skor ba'i chos grogs yin//ar ka bcag pa'i chos grogs yin//gzhas la zhi ba ma zhu zhi ba zhu//gzhas la zhi ba rdo rje brag la 'gyur//rdo rje brag de mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//rdo rje brag de lha shing shug par 'gyur//lha shing shug pa mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//lha shing shug pa dmar po'i me la 'gyur//dmar po'i me de mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//dmar po'i me de sngon po'i du bar 'gyur//sngon po'i du ba mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//sngon po'i du ba sprin bzang dkar por 'gyur//126

sprin bzang dkar po mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//sprin bzang dkar po sbrang char sil mar 'gyur//sbrang char sil ma mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//sbrang char sil ma lo yag rtsa bar 'gyur//lo yag rtsa ba mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//lo yag rtsa ba dkar po'i nas la 'gyur//dkar mo'i nas de mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//dkar po'i nas de a ma chang mar 'gyur//a ma chang ma mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//a ma chang ma chang dang ja khrar 'gyur//chang dang ja khra mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//chang dang ja khra stag shar gzhon par 'gyur//stag shar gzhon pa mi 'gyur dgu 'gyur 'gyur//stag shar gzhon pa dman chung bu mor 'gyur//de nas rdo rje brag gi bshad pa rdzogs//bshad pa ma rdzogs bstod pa rdzogs//bshad pa bstod pa mnyam du rdzogs//mang tsam 'dug te'i nyung tsam zhus//mang nyung ran pa'i tshig la mdud pa brgyab//de ga tsam la tshig mtshams ma bcad na//ko ba rgad nas gser shog 'khyog dogs med//bu mo rgad nas g.yu chung 'khyog dogs med//mdzo mo rgad nas rwa co 'khyog dogs med//lcang ma rgad nas 'bu srin 'khyog dogs med//127

yod dag zer gyis//da ga 'dra po skyin pa da lta khyer shog ma zhus//snyan po'i glu yi skyin pa 'phral ma nyid du khyer shog /sha ba lan mos 'grigayang bskyar lan mos 'grigagacig gnyis/ gsum byas/bzhi/ lnga/ drug byas/khyed rang brgya sde'i khrom pa snyan re gsan//o los glu gar tshig gsum e shes bltas//shes pa rnams tshos gzhas la rogs skyor gnang //ma shes rnams tshos gzhas la gzigs mo gzigs//ma shes gzhas la phebs na ngo re tsha//ma shes gzhas la phebs na yid rang mug /dang po ma chags dang po chags nas byung //dang po gnas bzang rdo rje brag chags nas byung //chags nas byung bas gnas bshad ma betang na//dang po slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' dang 'gal//gnyis pa chos grogs nga tsho'i dam tshig 'gal//chos grogs nga tsho chos grogs 'dra sa med//gnas bzang tsa ri skor ba'i chos grogs yin//ar ka bcag pa'i chos grogs yin//gzhas la zhi ba ma zhu zhi ba zhu//gzhas la zhi ba zer ba ngas//128

rdo rje brag la med pa gcig kyang med//rdo rje brag la gser gyi mchod rten yod//rtse mo yi la dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//klung rta yar skyes dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//sked pa de la ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//bsod nams can gyi ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//rtsa ba ma na skor ba bskor sa yod//rgan rgon rnams tsho skor ba bskor sa yod//rdo rje brag la med pa gcig kyang med//rdo rje brag la dngul gyi mchod rten yod//rtse mo yi la dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//klung rta yar skyes dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//sked pa de la ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//bsod nams can gyi ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//rtsa ba ma na skor ba bskor sa yod//rgan rgon rnams tsho skor ba bskor sa yod//rdo rje brag la med pa gcig kyang med//rdo rje brag la g.yu yi mchod rten yod//rtse mo yi la dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//klung rta yar skyes dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//sked pa de la ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//bsod nams can gyi ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//rtsa ba ma na skor ba bskor sa yod//rgan rgon rnams tsho skor ba bskor sa yod//129

rdo rje brag la med pa gcig kyang med//rdo rje brag la dung gi mchod rten yod//rtse mo yi la dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//klung rta yar skyes dar lcog 'dzugs sa yod//sked pa ya na ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//bsod nams can gyi ma ṇi 'bul sa yod//rtsa ba ma tsha skor ba bskor sa yod//rgan rgon rnams tsho skor ba bskor sa yod// gcig gnyis/ gsum byas/khyed rang brgya sde khrom pa snyan re gsan//o los glu gar tshig gsum e shes bltas//shes pa rnams tshos gzhas la rogs skyor gnang //ma shes rnams tshos gzhas la gzigs mo gzigs//ma shes gzhas la phebs na ngo re tsha//ma shes gzhas la phebs na yid rang mug /dang po chags nas ma byung chags nas byung //dang po rdo rje brag 'di chags nas byung //chags nas byung bas gnas bshad ma btang na//dang po slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' dang 'gal//gnyis pa chos grogs nga tsho'i dam tshig 'gal//chos grogs dang ni chos grogs 'dra sa med/gnas bzang tsa ri bskor ba'i chos grogs yin//ar ka bcag pa'i chos grogs yin//130

gzhas la zhi ba ma zhu zhi ba zhu//gzhas la zhi ba rdo rje brag la 'gyur//rdo rje brag gi gzhung la phyin pas//tshe ring lags so'o//rig 'dzin chen mo lags kyis//g.yon gyi phyogs nas gzigs byung //g.yas kyi phyogs nas gzigs byung //ri de g.yas ri'i ldebs nas//spa ma bkog shog gsungs kyis//ri de g.yon ri'i ldebs nas//shug pa bkog shog gsungs kyis//spa ma ba lu 'dres pa'i//lha bsangs gtong shog gsungs kyis//rtsa ba'i bla mas gnang ba'i// gru tsi tshal ga'i 'og 'jug /yar la mjal dar phul bas//mar la ljags mdud gnang byung //ljags mdud ske la gyon nas// rang yul phyogs la log 'gro//rang yul skyid po med kyang //bzas sna 'dzoms po yog red//yar yang bskyar gcig gsan parazhu/mar yang bskyar gcig snyan par zhu/gcig gnyis/ gsum byas/131

bzhi/ lnga/ drug byas/khyed rang brgya sde khrom pas snyan re gsan//o los glu gar tshig gsum e shes bltas//shes pa rnams tshos gzhas la rogs skyor gnang //ma shes rnams tshos gzhas la gzigs mo gzigs//ma shes gzhas la phebs na ngo re tsha//ma shes gzhas la phebs na yid rang mug /dang po chags nas ma byung chags nas byung //dang po dwags po rong 'di chags nas byung //chags nas byung bas gnas bshad ma btang na//dang po slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' dang 'gal//gnyis pa chos grogs nga tsho'i dam tshig 'gal//chos grogs dang ni chos grogs 'dra sa med//gnas bzang tsa ri bskor ba'i chos grogs yin//ar ka bcag pa'i chos grogs yin//gzhas la zhi ba ma zhu zhi ba zhu//nga yis dwags po'i rong la bshad pa zhu//chos grogs dwags po'i rong la thad mkhan tsho//dwags po'i chu mo'i rong la thad mkhan tsho//dwags po'i rong la gser gyi zam pa yod//gser gyi zam pa'i sgang la thad zer na//dgon pa brgya la gser shog sgron rogs gnang //dgon pa brgya la gser shog sgron zer na//gser shog zam pa'i sgang la thad rogs gnang //132

dgon pa brgya la gser shog ma sgron na//gser shog zam pa'i sgang la thad rgyu med//ya 'o na/ o los glu mo tshig gsum e shes bltas/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ glu mo shes pa gcig gis btang ba na/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ po ta la nas rgya gling btang ba 'dra/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ glu mo ma shes gcig gis btang ba na/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ a rogs khams pa ma ṇi bgrangs pa 'dra/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ zhabs bro shes pa gcig gis brgyab pa na/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ gzims chung chen po ar ka gcog mkhan 'dra/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ zhabs bro ma shes gcig gis brgyab pa na/ ya 'o na/ya 'o na/ bong bu rgan khog 'dam la tshud pa 'dra/ ya 'o na/133

༷ ༷ni — dhe ༷ ngal rtsol ga'an/ / ༷ bye / / / ༷ ༷ nags las kyi gzhas//sa la la la la sa la la la sa la la (lhun grub rdzong /)a ma'i bu chung bskal bzang //lcang gcod rgyag par ma 'gro//gnas chen rwa sgreng gnas chen//shug pa'i dkyil la chags yod//a ma'i bu chung bskal bzang //lcang gcod rgyag par ma 'gro//shwa ba sgom chen yin zer//sgom sgrub brgyab ste bsdad yod//a ma'i bu chung bskal bzang //lcang gcod rgyag par ma 'gro//'jol mo gzhas ma yin zer//134

gsung gzhas gnang ste bzhugs yod//sa sa la ge sa blo la ge la la la la la (gzhis rtse rdzong /)da lo lcang gsar yin pa//lcang gsar yar skyes yin pa//lcang gsar yar skyes yin pas//pho brang bstan pa zin song //skyid la gzhong gzhong la//yar 'gro'i lcang gsar la//lcang gsar dras kha snyom pa//nor bu gling gi lcang ma//gshol po mgo lus mtshungs pa//mi la smon dgos mi 'dug /skal bzang yar 'gro la//g.yas su lcang dkar btab yod//lcang dkar mda' las 'drong ba//g.yon du lcang smug btab yod//lcang smug smug khra shig shig /lcang dkar lcang dkar bar du//klu mo'i klu khang bzhengs yod//klu mo mjal 'dod yod na//klu rdzas bsnams te phebs shog /klu rdzas mang po mi dgos//dar tshon sna lngas 'grigs pa//135

dkar po bye ma'i dkyil la//chung chung lcang gsar btab yod//na ning btab pa'i lcang gsar//da lo ka gdung ran song //ka bzhi gdung brgyad nang du/gzigs mo gzigs la phebs dang //ya la yar lung lcang gseb//dpon po phyag mda' gnang sa//bzhugs nyams kyi spro ba la//zhabs bro phyi la shig shig /'dug se kha la brgyab yod//phyi yi dgra bo 'dul dus//'dug se kha la btul yod//zhabs bro nang la rub rub//'dug se kha la rub yod//nang gi gnyen 'go skyong dus//'dug se kha la bskyangs yod//la la la sa la la la la la la la (rin spungs rdzong /)yur po gong gi chu de//klu lding nang la 'gyur yod//klu lding nang gi lcang ma//yar skyes yong ba yod do//lcang ma yar skyes byung na//136

byi'u chung gnas bzod bde ba//gnas bzod bde po byung na//yal ga re re'i steng nas//gsung snyan re re gnang dang //bag chags re re zhogs dang //phu na srid pa'i gengs ri//'gyur med stod kyi gangs bzang //bar na khrom dus bzhengs yod//khrom dus shel dkar rgyal rtse//mda' na lcang gling bzhengs yod//lcang gling smug khra shig shig /nor bu sgang gi chu sna//klu lding nang du 'gyur yod//klu lding nang gi lcang ma//yar rgyas yong nga yod do//a jos lcang gseb shar la//lcang chu 'dren la phyin pas//nga la rtsa ba'i bla mas//yar shog bka' gcig gnang byung //yar la phyin pa'i dus su//lha chos zhus shog gsung byung //lha chos zhu bar 'gro la//137

'dzoms pa rnam gsum dgos kyis//'dzoms pa rnam gsum byung na//o los lha chos zhus chog /lha sar lcang ma ma btsugs//lha sar lcang ma btsugs yod//lha sar lcang ma btsugs nas//lcang rtse dgung dang mnyam byung //lcang rtse dgung dang mnyam bzhin//lcang lo sa la 'khyil byung // lcang lo sa la 'khyil nas//lha sa'i bstan pa dar song //lcang ma yar skyes yin pas//lcang gcod skyon pa ma gnang //sa sa sa sa sa sa la la sa la (gro mo rdzong /)lcang ma lcang gsar yin pas//lcang gcod bskyon pa ma gnang //byi'u chung a ma med pa'i//blo gtad de la bcol yod//shing sdong a pha yin zer//rtsa ba de nas gcod shog /gzim chung ka bzhi gdung brgyad//138

gdung ma zhu bar 'gro dgos//shing sdong a ma yin zer// sked pa de nas gcod shog /gzim chung ka bzhi gdung brgyad//lcam rgyug zhu bar 'gro dgos//shing gi yal ga yin zer//rtse mo de nas gcod shog /gzim chung ka bzhi gdung brgyad//dral ma zhu bar 'gro dgos//sa la la blo la blo sa la la la (skyid grong rdzong /)bla ma'i gzim chung yin zer//tsan dan dkar dmar dgos kyis//dpon po'i gzim chung yin zer//shug sdong dkar po dgos kyis//o los sta gri 'khur nas//lcang gseb dkyil nas 'gro dus//bdag la byi'u chung 'jol mos//'di 'dra ma zhig gsung byung //a co o she o she//lcang rtsa gcod pa ma gnang //139

byi'u chung bdag gi byi'u tshang //lcang ma'i rtse la bsags yod//la la la sa la la la la sa la sa (kong po rgya mda' rdzong /)ri 'di g.yas ri g.yon ri//lha shing shug pa'i gdan sa//lha shing shug pa'i dkyil la//'jol mo gsung gzhas snyan pa//phu la gangs ri chags yod//mda' la shing sna 'dzoms pa//brang rdzong mtsho mo'i steng la//ngang pa skyid nyal brgyab 'dug /bon ri gnas chen ri bo//nyams bzang ya la gzigs dang //lha shing shug pa khong gis//g.yon bskor brgyab ste bsdad 'dug /la la sa sa sa sa la sa la la sa ko gru gtong glu/ sa la la la la la la sa la la la (stod lung bde chen rdzong /)ko ba 'phred la btang bas//140

chu mo'i gzhung la 'khyer song //ko ba kho rang las 'phro//chu mo'i gzhung la yod 'gro//nga tsho chos grogs lhan rgyas//ko ba gang gi 'grul pa//ko stod 'gyur ba ma gtong //ko smad las kyis 'khor yong //sa la la la la sa la la sa la (sna dkar rtse rdzong /)chu mo'i gzhung la 'gro dus//chu brgyud rgyal pos mkhyen no//rang mgo rang gis thon dus//chu brgyud rgyal po gsol chog /ko ba bya las mgyogs pa//mnyan dpon lha las mtshar ba//de 'dra'i mnyan dpon mtshan la//bya mgyogs lha mdzes zhus chog /chu mo rab chen rab chung //ga par brgal brgal bzhag nas//sman chung ko ba'i nang la//gru rdzongs skyon pa ma gnang //141

chu mo'i 'khris la bzhengs pa'i// pho brang nor rgyas khang gsar//chu mos shang shang ma zer//nor rgyas khang gsar dran byung //3chu mo rgyang mkhar chu mo//'phar chag de 'dra'i che ba//dbyar kha mdzo phos mi 'thung //dgun kha ja chu mi nyan//ko ba chu mo'i dkyil la//yong gis bsam pa ma gtogs//ko ba'i nang gi yid 'phrog /yod 'gro bsam pa ma byung //sa la la la blo la la blo sa sa (mtsho smad rdzong /)gru de dang po gang gi gru ras//gru de dang po gser gyi gru red//gser gyi gru de gong thang che ba//gong thang che ba'i gru zhig gtong rogs//gru de gnyis pa gang gi gru ras//gru de gnyis pa g.yu yi gru red//142

g.yu yi gru de kha dog mtshar ba//kha dog mtshar ba'i gru zhig gtong rogs//gru de gsum pa gang gi gru ras//gru de gsum pa dung gi gru red// dung gi gru de rgyang gsal che ba/rgyang gsal che ba'i gru zhig gtong rogs//la la la sa la la sa sa sa sa sa sa la sa (gong dkar rdzong /)ko ba chu mo'i gzhung la//'gro gis bsam pa ma gtogs//mnyan dpon bsod nams 'brug rgyal//yin 'gro bsam pa ma byung //ko ba chu mo'i gzhung la//ma gtong gsung mkhan yod na//ko ba rdo rje brag gi//brag zur yi la bcad chog /lcags so g.yas kyi slob dpon//sgrub thob thang stong rgyal po//lcags so g.yon gyi slob dpon//lha chen tshangs pa rgyal chen// lcags so'i dkyil gyi slob dpon//143

bla ma o rgyan pad+ma//la la la sa go la la (sne gdong rdzong /)gtsang po'i pha rir bzhugs pa//a ṇi dam chos pad mo//khyed rang 'jon po yod na//gtsang po bcad nas phebs shig /chu mo kha zheng che yang //gru shan rta mgo'i 'og red//zam pa dbu dpangs mtho yang //rkang chung g.yas pa'i 'og red//ko ba btang nas ma 'gro//don grub pad+ma snying rje/don grub pad+ma 'dra ba'i//'dra sku bzhengs rogs gnang dang //sa la sa la sa la la la sa la sa la la (chu shur rdzong /)ko ba nam phyed gtong rgyu//sde pa gzhung gi bka' red//'od gsal mchi ma ma gtong //ko gru btang nas slebs yong //144

gru de lha mthong gshan khar//gru rdzongs bskyon pa ma gnang //gru gla nga ras sprad yod//sdug srog bskyal snying 'dod yong //sa sa sa sa la la sa la sa (rin spungs rdzong /)ko ba 'phred la btang bas//chu mo'i gzhung la 'khyer song //gang ltar 'khyer ni 'khyer song //las 'gro'i phyogs la 'khyer shog /chu mo rgyang mkhar phu chu//'phar chag de 'dra'i che ba//dbyar kha mdzo phos mi chod//dgun kha ja chu chad song //la sa la la sa sa sa la sa la sa snam bu 'chag bcag glu/sa sa la sa sa sa sa ma sa la sa (stag rtse rdzong /)dman chung bu mo 'chag la phebs shog /ge sar rgyal po'i na bza' yin no//seng lcam 'brug mo'i na bza' yin no//de ring 'chag la ma phebs na//145

sang nyin 'chag la phebs dgos med//ka brgyad brag phub nang gi /rje btsun 'phags mo sgrol ma//'chag gzhong gzhong pa'i nang gi /o lo'i snam bur gzigs nas//gangs la nyi shar yong ba'i//thugs smon tshig gsum bskyon dang //'chag la phebs dang phebs dang //bu mo g.yu gzhong sgrol dkar//de ring 'chag la ma phebs zer na//sang nyin 'chag la phebs dgos med do//dman chung bu mo'i sems pa 'di tsho//dam pa'i chos la 'gro gi yin no//dman chung bu mo gcig se a la//dman chung bu mo gnyis se a la//dman chung bu mo gsum gsum//sa sa sa sa blo sa blo sa la la ma (sa skya rdzong /) 'chag gi dang po yul lha gzhi bdag slong lo//yul lha gzhi bdag o lo bdag la mi mnyes pa med//'chag gzhong 'di la sgor ba'i//'u cag mnyam mnyam gzhon gzhon//146

snam bu 'di 'dra 'di 'dra tsam byas//rubs su rub pa gnang shog /'brong pos dbyar rtswa bzas pa'i//ko ba 'dra zhig thon shog /'brong la dbyar chu btung pa'i //mjing pa 'dra zhig thon shog /snam bu'i gral stod sgrims pa shog /gral stod 'od kyis khengs pa shog /rang yul 'od kyis khengs pa shog /mi yul sgro 'dogs chod pa shog /'chag gi dang po yul lha gzhi bdag la yin//yul lha gzhi bdag o lo bdag la mi mnyes pa med//'chag tha ma bcag yin//bzhob btang pa bzhob len//'chag skyed med par//bzhob skyed yod//snam bu'i gral stod sgrims par shog /gral stod 'od kyis khengs par shog /snam bur 'chag ma phyin na//bu mo nga tsho chos la 'gro//la blojas sa sa blojablo blo (rin spungs rdzong /)'chag de a ce'i 'chag red//147

a ce rgya bza'i 'chag red//bal de g.yang mo'i bal red//g.yang mo lug gi bal red//'brong la dbyar rtswa bzas pa'i//ko ba 'dra zhig shog cig /'brong chung rdza chu btung pa'i//mjing pa 'dra zhig shog cig /0148
